name: GDB
recent: GDB Holdings 最近获得一份价值 RM877 million 的 Shah Alam 物流中心建筑合约，使订单创下 RM2.93 billion 的纪录。公司同时获得法院判决，Conlay Construction 需支付 RM4.6 million。此外，Santraprise Sdn. Bhd. 成为持股 5.005% 的大股东。
notable: 获得价值 RM877 million 的 Shah Alam 物流中心建筑合约。
法院判决 Conlay Construction 向公司支付 RM4.6 million。
Santraprise Sdn. Bhd. 成为持股 5.005% 的大股东。
risks: 一名独立非执行董事在公开市场出售股份。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM142.482 million，环比下降 15.7%，同比下降 21.2%；净利为 RM13.197 million，环比下降 38.7%，同比下降 39.3%；净利率为 9.3%，低于上一季度的 12.7%。

recent_en: GDB Holdings recently secured a RM877 million logistics hub construction contract in Shah Alam, bringing its order book to a record RM2.93 billion. The company also won a court judgement of RM4.6 million against Conlay Construction. In addition, Santraprise Sdn. Bhd. became a substantial shareholder with a 5.005% stake.
notable_en: Secured a RM877 million logistics hub construction contract in Shah Alam.
Court judgement awarded RM4.6 million to the company against Conlay Construction.
Santraprise Sdn. Bhd. became a substantial shareholder with a 5.005% stake.
risks_en: An independent non-executive director disposed of shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM142.482 million, down 15.7% QoQ and 21.2% YoY; net income was RM13.197 million, down 38.7% QoQ and 39.3% YoY; net margin was 9.3%, lower than 12.7% in the previous quarter.
